Our Services

Technology Services for Businesses in Nigeria and Africa

DiscoveryTech Hub offers web design and development, software and AI solutions, mobile apps, e-commerce, digital marketing, ICT systems integration, gadget supply and maintenance, and IT training. We work with startups, small and medium businesses, schools, NGOs, and professional firms across Nigeria and Africa, and deliver most projects remotely.

Web Design, Development & Hosting

Fast, mobile-friendly websites that look professional, rank on Google, and stay online.

Software Development & IT Consultancy

Custom software and practical IT advice that saves time, reduces errors, and grows with you.

AI Solutions & Automation

Practical AI tools, chatbots, and automation that save time and help your team do more.

ICT Solutions & Systems Integration

Connected systems, automated workflows, and reliable ICT infrastructure for your organisation.

Digital Marketing & Social Media Management

Social media, content, and campaigns that bring in enquiries and keep your brand active.

Mobile Application Development

Easy-to-use Android and iOS apps built around what your users actually need.

E-Commerce Development & Management

Online stores that accept local and international payments and are managed for you.

IT Training & Technical Support

Practical digital skills training and responsive technical support when something goes wrong.

Gadgets Supply & Maintenance

Reliable laptops, phones, and accessories, plus repairs and regular maintenance to keep them running.
